Icelandic original: „Ég er ættuð frá Seyðisfirði og finnst Seyðisfjörður vera fallegasti bær á Íslandi og alltaf gott að koma þangað.“
English gloss: “I am from Seyðisfjörður and think Seyðisfjörður is the most beautiful town in Iceland and it is always good to go there.”

faithful.instructions: Is the English gloss a faithful translation of the Icelandic original, with no added or missing meaning?
